name: mem_context
description: Get recent memory context from previous sessions. Shows recent sessions and observations to understand what was done before.

compact.description: Drop the inline content preview from observation bullets to save tokens.

max_bytes.description: Total context budget in bytes. Default 16384; values above 65536 are clamped to 65536.

older_history.description: Include a bounded Older History overview with counts and sampled titles outside the recent window.

project.description: Filter by project (omit for all projects)

scope.description: Filter observations by scope: project, personal, or global. Omit to apply no scope filter.
